text: 道指开盘跌0.13%，纳指涨0.33%，标普500涨0.21%。明星科技股奈飞涨1.59%，美国超微公司涨1.46%，Meta Platforms涨1.31%。纳斯达克中国金龙指数跌0.84%，蔚来跌3.82%，小鹏集团跌3.02%。
text_en: The Dow opened down 0.13%, the Nasdaq rose 0.33%, and the S&P 500 rose 0.21%. Among star technology stocks, Netflix rose 1.59%, Advanced Micro Devices rose 1.46%, and Meta Platforms rose 1.31%. The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index fell 0.84%, with NIO down 3.82% and XPeng Group down 3.02%.
